rows.hypothesis: MTF SMC price action replicates across instruments
rows.verdict_detail: re-run on the engine corrected on 2026-09-27 (run at commit 631f33d, code_hash 07f155612e0c70dc); the pre-registered rule (docs/SPEC_multi_instrument.md §7) gives the same verdict as before the fix
rows.mechanism: No configuration is positive and significant on even one of the five instruments, 0/210 cells survive the cross-instrument BH-FDR, the L1 walk-forward is negative out of sample, and cross-instrument return correlation leaves an effective 3.45/5 independent instruments.

stats.label: config x instrument cells surviving cross-instrument BH-FDR
stats.locator: column p_value over all 210 rows (NaN -> 1); BH at alpha 0.05 via mtf_smc.robustness.stats.benjamini_hochberg

stats.label: configs positive-and-significant on >= 2 instruments
stats.locator: rows with n_pos_sig >= 2, over all 42 rows

stats.label: L1 walk-forward pooled OOS E[R]
stats.locator: mean of every trade R in column oos_R_json (24 windows, N = 438)

stats.label: L1 walk-forward window-block 95% CI
stats.locator: mtf_smc.robustness.stats.block_bootstrap_mean_ci over the 24 windows' oos_R_json (defaults: 10,000 draws, seed 7)

stats.label: L1 walk-forward calendar OOS periods with E[R] < 0
effective number of independent instruments
stats.locator: 5x5 daily-return correlation matrix; participation ratio via mtf_smc.robustness.replication.participation_ratio

caveats: Every strategy statistic is from the 2026-09-27 re-run on the corrected engine (take-profit swings confirmed before use; fills resolved before the close-based cancel; stops honoured on the fill bar); old -> new values in docs/ADDENDUM_2026-09-27.md §11
The 24 walk-forward windows are 12 calendar periods shared by XAUUSD and EURUSD; the sign test runs on the 12 periods
The two eye-catching cells (+2.00 R XAUUSD, +1.05 R GBPJPY, HTF_level) are bit-identical before and after the fix and remain non-significant (N 17 and 23)
The effective 3.45/5 comes from daily price-return correlation, which the engine fixes do not affect
The gold study's one-time OOS 2023-2025 figure (docs/REPORT.md §7) predates the fix and was not recomputed; the re-run does not reopen that window
